title: Jiff 1.0: A datetime library for Rust
why_read: A 1.0 release of a serious new datetime library for Rust, relevant to anyone dealing with timezones and calendar math in that ecosystem.
analysis: Jiff is a Rust library for handling dates, times, and timezones, reaching its 1.0 stable release. Datetime handling is notoriously full of edge cases—leap seconds, timezone database quirks, calendar arithmetic—so a well-designed library reaching maturity is a genuinely useful infrastructure milestone. Rust's existing datetime ecosystem (chrono, time) has had friction points, so a new robust option is relevant to engineers building systems that need correct time handling. This is a solid, substantive library release rather than a flashy announcement.
